<span id="A6.p6.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:45.97em;">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p6.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;">Investigation trace: cat at the wheel</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 14.89 10.95)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:53em;--ltx-fo-height:100.3em;--ltx-fo-depth:0em;font-size:10pt;" height="1387.85" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 1387.85)" width="733.37"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content"><span id="A6.p6.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:53em;">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;--ltx-bg-color:#000000;"> Step 1 </span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Main agent  <span id="A6.p6.pic1.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">common_sense[0.0--5.0 s]</span></span></span>
</span><span class="ltx_rule ltx_align_left" style="width:100%;height:0.4pt;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;">Reasoning.</span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The sequence presents a highly unusual staged-looking interaction: a cat appears positioned at the steering wheel of a small red car, while an officer stands beside it and a police vehicle is behind them. Before assessing rendering artifacts, the first question is whether the depicted action is physically and semantically plausible. A common-sense review across the full five-second interval can test whether the cat’s posture, apparent control of the vehicle, officer’s behavior, and vehicle motion form a coherent real-world event. This broad temporal scope is useful because a single frame could make an unusual but possible arrangement seem credible, whereas repeated frames may reveal whether the cat actually interacts with the controls or whether the scene remains frozen. The result should establish whether the central premise itself is credible, while leaving image-generation artifacts and text quality for separate checks.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A6.p6.pic1.p3.pic1" class="ltx_picture" color="#000000" height="167.92" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 623.38 167.92" width="623.38"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,167.92) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 0 L 0 167.92 L 623.38 167.92 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 2.77 0 L 2.77 167.92 L 623.38 167.92 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 15.01 8.86)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:50.92em;--ltx-fo-height:12.95em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.18em;font-size:8.5pt;" height="154.51" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 152.36)" width="598.91"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p3.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:50.92em;">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p3.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p3.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Sub-agent returns.</span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p3.pic1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;"> </span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p3.pic1.1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#B03030;">issue<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p3.pic1.1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium"> (high)</span></span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p3.pic1.1.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">. The scene presents a cat as the apparent driver of a full-size road car, seated upright behind the steering wheel and apparently operating it while a police officer writes a ticket beside the vehicle. The cat’s paws are placed on the wheel, but there is no visible human operator, restraint, or other mechanism that would make the cat’s control of the vehicle plausible. The officer’s ticketing behavior is coherent on its own, yet the central event depends on an animal performing a human driving task without a credible causal explanation. The car remains stationary in the sampled frames, so the anomaly is not based on an observed crash or impossible movement; it is the depicted affordance and action itself. The scene therefore conflicts with ordinary animal capabilities and vehicle operation.</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</span>
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;--ltx-bg-color:#000000;"> Step 2 </span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p4.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p4.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Main agent  <span id="A6.p6.pic1.p4.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">visual_appearance[0.0--5.0 s]</span></span></span>
</span><span class="ltx_rule ltx_align_left" style="width:100%;height:0.4pt;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;">Reasoning.</span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p5.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The preceding assessment identifies a strong plausibility concern centered on the cat’s apparent role as driver, but that concern does not by itself distinguish a deliberately staged scene from synthetic imagery. The next useful test is temporal visual consistency across the same complete interval. Comparing the cat’s face, paws, vehicle edges, officer, police car, and background can reveal whether details remain stable as the officer changes pose and the apparent vehicle motion progresses. Particular attention should go to fine boundaries and repeated structures, since generated imagery often preserves the broad composition while subtly regenerating local features between frames. This check can either provide independent support for an artificial origin or show that the unusual premise is visually coherent. It should remain focused on appearance continuity rather than re-evaluating the semantic plausibility already examined.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A6.p6.pic1.p6.pic1" class="ltx_picture" color="#000000" height="184.53" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 623.38 184.53" width="623.38"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,184.53) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 0 L 0 184.53 L 623.38 184.53 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 2.77 0 L 2.77 184.53 L 623.38 184.53 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 15.01 8.86)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:50.92em;--ltx-fo-height:14.37em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.18em;font-size:8.5pt;" height="171.12" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 168.97)" width="598.91"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p6.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:50.92em;">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p6.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p6.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Sub-agent returns.</span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p6.pic1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;"> </span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p6.pic1.1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#B03030;">issue<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p6.pic1.1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium"> (medium)</span></span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p6.pic1.1.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">. The scene has a conspicuously smooth, rendered appearance, most evident in the cat’s face and the officer’s exposed skin. Across the opening views, the cat’s forehead, cheeks, and muzzle have broad, softly blended fur shading with little fine strand detail, while its eyes and facial outline remain unusually clean and graphic. The officer’s cheek, forehead, and forearms similarly show smooth tonal transitions and simplified surface detail. This treatment contrasts with the more sharply delineated road texture, vehicle edges, and clothing outlines. The concern is the persistent synthetic softness of the subjects, rather than a definite change in identity or a lighting contradiction. The visible evidence supports an appearance anomaly with moderate confidence; it does not establish a specific temporal flicker or a particular facial feature changing shape.</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</span>
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p7.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;--ltx-bg-color:#000000;"> Step 3 </span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p7.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p7.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Main agent  <span id="A6.p6.pic1.p7.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">ocr_consistency[@ 2.0 s]</span></span></span>
</span><span class="ltx_rule ltx_align_left" style="width:100%;height:0.4pt;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p8.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p8.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;">Reasoning.</span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p8.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The two preceding checks leave the main question focused on whether the scene’s visible text behaves like ordinary photographed signage. The license plate is prominent and contains a short, high-contrast word, making it a useful localized test: generated images often produce readable-looking lettering with unstable or malformed character boundaries, while genuine text may remain structurally consistent even when slightly blurred. Inspecting the plate at the specified two-second point is appropriate because it is clearly visible in the supplied chronology and can be evaluated independently of the cat-and-driver premise. This is a narrow corroborating check, not a standalone authenticity test. Its value depends on whether the lettering is legible and whether any irregularity is localized to the text rather than caused by general image softness, perspective, or compression.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A6.p6.pic1.p9.pic1" class="ltx_picture" color="#000000" height="151.19" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 623.38 151.19" width="623.38"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,151.19) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 0 L 0 151.19 L 623.38 151.19 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 2.77 0 L 2.77 151.19 L 623.38 151.19 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 15.01 8.86)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:50.92em;--ltx-fo-height:11.53em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.18em;font-size:8.5pt;" height="137.79" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 135.63)" width="598.91"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p9.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:50.92em;">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Sub-agent returns.</span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;"> </span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#B03030;">text suspicious<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium"> (medium)</span></span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">. </span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic" style="font-size:80%;">Issues:</span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;"> Localized background plate lettering is structurally unreadable and appears melted or unresolved; The clear foreground plate provides a strong contrast with the degraded background plate text. </span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic" style="font-size:80%;">Reason:</span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1.8" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;"> One localized text region shows generation-like glyph dissolution and unstable character structure, while the other is regular and legible.</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</span>
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p10.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p10.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;--ltx-bg-color:#000000;"> Step 4 </span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p10.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p10.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Main agent: final verdict  <span id="A6.p6.pic1.p10.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#B03030;">answer(fake)</span></span></span>
</span><span class="ltx_rule ltx_align_left" style="width:100%;height:0.4pt;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A6.p6.pic1.p11.pic1" class="ltx_picture" color="#000000" height="187.14" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 623.38 187.14" width="623.38"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,187.14) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 0 L 0 187.14 L 623.38 187.14 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 2.77 0 L 2.77 187.14 L 623.38 187.14 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 15.01 6.7)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:50.92em;--ltx-fo-height:14.77em;--ltx-fo-depth:0em;font-size:8.5pt;" height="173.73" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 173.73)" width="598.91"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p11.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:50.92em;">
<span id="A6.p6.pic1.p11.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p11.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Verdict.</span><span id="A6.p6.pic1.p11.pic1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;"> The evidence converges on a synthetic or otherwise non-real depiction. The strongest finding is the high-confidence common-sense issue: the cat is presented as the apparent driver of a road vehicle, with paws on the wheel but no credible mechanism explaining how it could operate the car. The officer’s ticketing behavior is coherent, but it does not resolve that central physical contradiction. Visual inspection adds moderate support, describing unusually smooth, rendered-looking fur and exposed skin, with simplified shading and clean graphic facial contours compared with sharper environmental details. The text check is also moderately suspicious: one localized plate region has melted or unresolved lettering, while another is clear, creating an inconsistent text-quality pattern. These appearance and text findings are not individually decisive, and the stationary vehicle limits motion-based inference, but together with the implausible central action they strongly favor an AI-generated scene. Therefore the media is fake.</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>

<span id="A6.p9.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:45.97em;">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p9.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;">Investigation trace: real street recording</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 14.89 10.95)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:53em;--ltx-fo-height:98.06em;--ltx-fo-depth:0em;font-size:10pt;" height="1356.91" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 1356.91)" width="733.37"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content"><span id="A6.p9.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:53em;">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;--ltx-bg-color:#000000;"> Step 1 </span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Main agent  <span id="A6.p9.pic1.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">visual_appearance[0.0--8.3 s]</span></span></span>
</span><span class="ltx_rule ltx_align_left" style="width:100%;height:0.4pt;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;">Reasoning.</span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The primary hypothesis is that this is a genuine continuous street recording, but the repeated frames should first be checked for visual artifacts that could indicate synthetic generation. I will examine the full available interval rather than a single image, focusing on whether fixed structures, signage, barriers, vehicles, pedestrians, and the moving foreground subject retain stable geometry and appearance. This broad temporal scope is useful because generated media may reveal inconsistent textures, object boundaries, lighting, or background details even when individual frames look plausible. The foreground man and stroller deserve particular attention because their motion provides a natural test of continuity, while the largely static street environment supplies a reference for detecting unexplained changes. At this stage, the goal is to establish whether there are visible appearance anomalies; physical plausibility and text legibility can be assessed separately afterward.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A6.p9.pic1.p3.pic1" class="ltx_picture" color="#000000" height="151.32" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 623.38 151.32" width="623.38"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,151.32) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 0 L 0 151.32 L 623.38 151.32 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 2.77 0 L 2.77 151.32 L 623.38 151.32 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 15.01 8.86)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:50.92em;--ltx-fo-height:11.54em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.18em;font-size:8.5pt;" height="137.91" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 135.76)" width="598.91"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p3.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:50.92em;">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p3.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p3.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Sub-agent returns.</span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p3.pic1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;"> </span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p3.pic1.1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#288246;">no issue<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p3.pic1.1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium"> (medium)</span></span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p3.pic1.1.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">. Across the sequence, the street scene retains consistent appearance: the storefront, road markings, barriers, buildings, trees, and parked vehicles keep their shapes, colors, and relative positions. The moving man and stroller remain visually coherent as they approach the left edge, with no clear boundary melting, duplication, or abrupt change in detail. Fine facial and clothing details are small, and the largely fixed viewpoint limits assessment of texture behavior under substantial motion or changing light. Within the visible regions, however, there is no distinct temporal appearance anomaly.</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</span>
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;--ltx-bg-color:#000000;"> Step 2 </span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p4.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p4.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Main agent  <span id="A6.p9.pic1.p4.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">physical_consistency[0.0--8.3 s]</span></span></span>
</span><span class="ltx_rule ltx_align_left" style="width:100%;height:0.4pt;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;">Reasoning.</span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p5.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The appearance review provides a basis for treating the scene as visually stable, but it does not by itself establish that the observed motion follows ordinary physical relationships. The next question is whether the man, stroller, road obstacles, vehicles, and surrounding structures move consistently through time. I will therefore inspect the same full interval with a physical-consistency analysis. This scope is appropriate because it can test continuity of trajectories, contact with the pavement, object persistence, and possible distortions such as teleportation, merging, splitting, or implausible deformation. The scene appears to contain limited motion, so the analysis should distinguish absence of detected violations from strong evidence about dynamics that are not sufficiently exercised. In particular, the stroller’s path toward the frame edge and the parked or distant traffic should be compared against the fixed barriers, road markings, and buildings. This step can either add support for authenticity or identify a concrete physical contradiction.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A6.p9.pic1.p6.pic1" class="ltx_picture" color="#000000" height="184.53" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 623.38 184.53" width="623.38"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,184.53) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 0 L 0 184.53 L 623.38 184.53 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 2.77 0 L 2.77 184.53 L 623.38 184.53 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 15.01 8.86)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:50.92em;--ltx-fo-height:14.37em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.18em;font-size:8.5pt;" height="171.12" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 168.97)" width="598.91"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p6.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:50.92em;">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p6.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p6.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Sub-agent returns.</span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p6.pic1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;"> </span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p6.pic1.1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#288246;">no issue<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p6.pic1.1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium"> (medium)</span></span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p6.pic1.1.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">. The visible motion is physically coherent across the sampled frames. A man pushes a stroller along the sidewalk from the middle-left toward the left edge, with the stroller maintaining a stable shape, orientation, and contact with the pavement. The child remains seated in the stroller, and the man’s posture and hand placement are consistent with the movement. The stroller wheels stay aligned with the sidewalk, and there is no visible teleportation, sudden acceleration, limb distortion, object splitting, or implausible collision. The road barriers, parked vehicles, buildings, and other rigid structures remain fixed in place. The 2 FPS sampling does not show every intermediate movement, so very fine kinematic details cannot be checked, but the observed progression over the full sequence is natural and continuous enough to support no physical-consistency issue.</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</span>
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p7.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;--ltx-bg-color:#000000;"> Step 3 </span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p7.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p7.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Main agent  <span id="A6.p9.pic1.p7.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">ocr_consistency[@ 4.0 s]</span></span></span>
</span><span class="ltx_rule ltx_align_left" style="width:100%;height:0.4pt;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p8.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p8.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;">Reasoning.</span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p8.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> 
The temporal and physical checks address motion and scene structure, while visible lettering remains an independent source of evidence. Synthetic imagery can produce unstable, malformed, or inconsistent text, especially on storefronts and road signs. I will inspect the text at the supplied four-second point, where the main signage is clearly visible, using OCR consistency rather than attempting to infer meaning from the scene alone. The useful scope is localized: the large shop sign, speed marking, and nearby directional or warning text can be checked for coherent glyph shapes and ordinary perspective effects. This single-time inspection cannot establish temporal text stability across the entire clip, and small or blurred lettering may remain unresolved, so it should be treated as supporting evidence only. Combined with the earlier full-range checks, however, it can reveal whether prominent readable regions show the characteristic warping or incoherence often associated with generated imagery.</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A6.p9.pic1.p9.pic1" class="ltx_picture" color="#000000" height="84.9" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 623.38 84.9" width="623.38"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,84.9) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 0 L 0 84.9 L 623.38 84.9 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 2.77 0 L 2.77 84.9 L 623.38 84.9 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 15.01 8.86)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:50.92em;--ltx-fo-height:5.9em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.18em;font-size:8.5pt;" height="71.49" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 69.34)" width="598.91"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p9.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:50.92em;">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Sub-agent returns.</span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;"> </span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#288246;">text ok<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium"> (high)</span></span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p9.pic1.1.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;">. All supplied text regions show coherent glyph structure consistent with ordinary photographed signage. Minor softness and stylization are present but do not produce visible warping or generation-like text anomalies.</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</span>
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p10.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p10.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;--ltx-bg-color:#000000;"> Step 4 </span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p10.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> </span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p10.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Main agent: final verdict  <span id="A6.p9.pic1.p10.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#288246;">answer(real)</span></span></span>
</span><span class="ltx_rule ltx_align_left" style="width:100%;height:0.4pt;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_align_left ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A6.p9.pic1.p11.pic1" class="ltx_picture" color="#000000" height="189.29" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 623.38 189.29" width="623.38"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,189.29) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 0 L 0 189.29 L 623.38 189.29 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 2.77 0 L 2.77 189.29 L 623.38 189.29 L 623.38 0 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 15.01 8.86)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:50.92em;--ltx-fo-height:14.77em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.18em;font-size:8.5pt;" height="175.89" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 173.73)" width="598.91"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p11.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:50.92em;">
<span id="A6.p9.pic1.p11.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p11.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:80%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Verdict.</span><span id="A6.p9.pic1.p11.pic1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:80%;"> The full-range visual assessment found no distinct temporal appearance anomaly: the storefront, road markings, barriers, buildings, trees, and vehicles remain consistent, while the man and stroller retain coherent shapes and detail as they move. The physical-consistency assessment independently found natural, continuous motion, with stable stroller orientation, pavement contact, posture, and hand placement, and no observed teleportation, splitting, limb distortion, or implausible collision. Both findings are medium-confidence and the 2 FPS sampling leaves fine intermediate kinematics unresolved, so they are supportive rather than absolute. The OCR check at four seconds was high-confidence and found coherent glyph structure across localized signage, with only minor softness or stylization. Its single-frame scope limits conclusions about text over time, but it provides no contradictory evidence. Taken together, the stable appearance, plausible motion, and coherent text favor an ordinary recorded scene rather than AI generation.</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</span></span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>
<div id="A6.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<div id="A6.p10.1" class="ltx_logical-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_middle" style="width:345.0pt;">
        
<figure id="A6.F17" class="ltx_figure">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure"><span id="A6.F17.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Figure 17</span>: </span><span id="A6.F17.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:90%;">Real street recording.<span id="A6.F17.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium"> Ground truth: real; WeVisForensics prediction: real; 8.3 s, with audio. Three independent checks return no issue, so the main agent concludes real.</span></span></figcaption>
</figure>
